reviews.title: Inaccurate Tajweed Notation
reviews.text: The app need to improve its Tajweed notation. Simply using different colors to indicate Tajweed rules is not sufficient. The actual Arabic symbols and markings should also be used correctly to distinguish between rules such as Izhar and Idgham, particularly in Tanwin. These distinctions are essential for users who rely on the app to recite the Quran independently and apply Tajweed correctly. Please consider incorporating accurate Tajweed notation rather than relying on color indications alone. The app is only good for either to read translation or listening recitation.
